posts.author: Abhijeet Bhalerao
posts.content:
Hi All, 
   
📢 We’re Hiring: Senior Power BI Analyst – Dubai (Onsite)

Accely is looking for an experienced Senior Power BI Analyst for a Dubai onsite engagement, supporting the Dubai time zone.
 
 🔹 Role: Power BI Analyst
 🔹 Work Mode: Dubai – Onsite
 🔹 Time Zone: Dubai, UAE
 
 Mandatory requirements
 
 We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Power BI Analyst to join our data and analytics Marketing team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining interactive dashboards and reports that transform raw data into actionable insights. This role requires a blend of technical proficiency, business acumen, and user-centric design thinking.
  
Required Skills
  
Proficiency      in Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, DAX, and Power      Query
Experience      with Azure, SharePoint, and Databricks
Strong      understanding of data visualization principles and UX/UI      design
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Dashboard      & Report Development: Design and build visually compelling,      interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI Desktop and Power BI      Service
Data      Modeling: Develop and maintain robust data models using star and      snowflake schema patterns; implement calculated columns and measures using      DAX
Front-End      Optimization: Ensure optimal performance and usability of dashboards,      including layout design, drill-through actions, bookmarks, and custom      visuals.
Data      Integration: Connect and transform data from multiple sources      (Databricks, SQL Server, Excel, APIs, etc.) using Power Query and ETL      processes.
Timesheet:      Fulfilled the MBRF standard timesheet with the main activities per day, to      share this for invoice proposal.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications & knowledge
  
PowerBI      Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate or equivalent certification
Understanding      of sales and commercial performance metrics.
Familiarity      with market share and retail analytics concepts.
Strong      analytical and problem-solving skills.
Effective      communication.
Exposure      to Nielsen, EPOS, or FMCG analytics is an advantage.
  
 
  
#Hiring #PowerBI #PowerBIAnalyst #PowerBIDeveloper #SeniorConsultant #DataAnalytics#Accely#Dubai
  

 📩 Interested candidates: Please share your updated CV or connect with us to discuss this opportunity.
 
 abhijeet.b@accely.com
 
 Regards, 
 Abhijeet Bhalerao

posts.author: Avocado Technology Consultants Co. LLC
posts.content:
We’re Hiring: Business Development Executive, Odoo ERP Sales (Immediate Joiner)

Are you a driven B2B salesperson who knows how to connect with business owners and spot operational bottlenecks? We are looking for a Business Development Executive to help us generate qualified leads and expand our Odoo ERP client base in the UAE.
If you understand how businesses operate, thrive on outbound prospecting, and want high earning potential selling one of the world’s fastest-growing all-in-one business software suites, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
Outbound Lead Generation: Proactively identify, prospect, and reach out to UAE decision-makers (Founders, CEOs, General Managers, Operations Heads) via LinkedIn, cold calling, email, and networking.
Discovery and Qualification: Conduct initial discovery calls to understand prospects' current pain points across Accounting, Inventory, CRM, Sales, or Manufacturing.
Demo Coordination: Book qualified product demonstrations and collaborate closely with our technical and functional consultants to present tailored Odoo solutions.
Pipeline Management: Maintain accurate records of leads, follow-ups, and deal progress in our CRM.

Requirements and Preferences
Visa and Availability: Candidates on Own Visa (Family, Freelance, or Spouse visa) and Immediate Joiners will be given strong preference.
Sales Experience: 1 to 2+ years of proven experience in B2B lead generation, SaaS sales, IT solutions, or software selling in the UAE.
ERP Familiarity: Prior experience selling Odoo or other ERPs (Zoho, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Tally) is a strong advantage, though full Odoo product training will be provided.
Communication: Fluent in English with strong presentation and negotiation skills. Arabic is a plus.
Mindset: Self-motivated, target-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced growth environment.

What We Offer
Salary: As per candidate experience and discussion, plus attractive commission on closed deals.
Location: Dubai, UAE
Support: Full pre-sales, technical demo, and implementation backing from an experienced Odoo team.

How to Apply
If you are available to join immediately and ready to build a strong sales pipeline, send your updated CV to contactus@avocadoconsulting.ae with the subject line "Odoo BDE Resume"
